methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 beginner-to-intermediate telescopes spanning refractor, Newtonian reflector, Schmidt-Cassegrain, and Dobsonian designs, including two discontinued models (Orion SkyQuest XT8, Zhumell Z130) retained because they remain widely searched and available used. Specs re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer product pages (celestron.com, skywatcherusa.com, gskyer.com) and major US retailers (Astronomics, OPT Telescopes/optcorp.com) plus independent review sites (telescopicwatch.com). Prices reflect published US MSRP or regular/list price in USD (regular price used where a sale price coexisted). Three corrections were applied during fact-check: Orion XT8 highest useful magnification corrected to the manufacturer-published 300x (the draft's 240x was a reviewer's practical figure); Sky-Watcher Classic 200P highest useful magnification corrected to 400x per skywatcherusa.com/Astronomics; Sky-Watcher Heritage 150P weight populated to 23.5 lb (8 lb OTA + 15.5 lb base) per Astronomics, which does publish it. Note: Zhumell is a Celestron-owned brand, so the celestron.com Z130 page is a legitimate corroboration source. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
